title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 07
description:
Elevate your bedroom with this personalized Baseball Comforter Set, designed for ultimate comfort and style. Featuring a dynamic baseball theme, this bedding set is a thoughtful gift for any baseball player, fan, or lover, bringing a touch of personalized flair to their space.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Perfect for baseball players, fans, and lovers, celebrating their passion for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection techniques for dye retention and fade prevention, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting durability.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric with whole-piece Microfiber Filling, ensuring a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat. Microfiber dries quickly and becomes fluffier after washing.
  • Personalized Design: Customize with 2 text inputs for a unique touch.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Fill Material Microfiber Filling
Selected Design Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 400
Included Components Duvet Cover
